questions.q: I wish I ___ harder for the exam.
questions.explanation: For regrets about the past, 'wish' takes the past perfect.

questions.q: If only she ___ me the truth.
questions.explanation: 'If only' about a past event takes the past perfect.

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.
options: I wish I hadn't said that to him.
I wish I didn't say that to him.
I wish I wouldn't have said that to him.
I wish I haven't said that to him.
questions.explanation: Regret about a past action needs 'wish + past perfect'.

questions.q: He wishes he ___ the job offer.
questions.explanation: Use the past perfect after 'wish' for a past regret.

questions.q: If only we ___ earlier — we missed the train.
questions.explanation: 'If only' expresses a past regret with the past perfect.

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.
options: She wishes she had never met him.
She wishes she never met him.
She wishes she would have never met him.
She wishes she has never met him.
questions.explanation: A past regret after 'wish' needs the past perfect.

questions.q: I wish it ___ yesterday — the match was cancelled.
questions.explanation: Use the negative past perfect for a past regret about the weather.

questions.q: If only I ___ my keys.
questions.explanation: 'If only' with a past regret takes the negative past perfect.

questions.q: They wish they ___ so much money.
questions.explanation: Regret about past spending needs 'wish + past perfect'.

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.
options: If only you told me sooner!
If only you would have told me sooner!
If only you'd told me sooner!
If only you have told me sooner!
questions.explanation: 'If only' about a missed past chance takes the past perfect.

questions.q: She wishes she ___ to university.
questions.explanation: A past life regret after 'wish' takes the past perfect.

questions.q: I wish we ___ that restaurant — the food was terrible.
questions.explanation: Regret about a past choice needs the past perfect.

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.
options: He wishes he listened to his doctor.
He wishes he would have listened to his doctor.
He wishes he has listened to his doctor.
He wishes he had listened to his doctor.
questions.explanation: 'Wish' about not following advice in the past takes the past perfect.

questions.q: If only the car ___ down on the motorway.
questions.explanation: Use the past perfect after 'if only' for a past breakdown.

questions.q: We wish we ___ a bigger flat.
questions.explanation: A past purchase regret takes 'wish + past perfect'.

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.
options: I wish I'd taken more photos on the trip.
I wish I took more photos on the trip.
I wish I'd take more photos on the trip.
I wish I've taken more photos on the trip.
questions.explanation: The contracted past perfect follows 'wish' for past regrets.

questions.q: She wishes her parents ___ her study abroad.
questions.explanation: Use the past perfect after 'wish' for a past permission regret.

questions.q: If only he ___ so rude to the waiter.
questions.explanation: 'If only' about past behaviour takes the past perfect.

questions.q: I wish I ___ my temper yesterday.
questions.explanation: Regret about yesterday's behaviour needs the past perfect.

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.
options: If only we didn't waste so much time!
If only we hadn't wasted so much time!
If only we wouldn't have wasted so much time!
If only we haven't wasted so much time!
questions.explanation: A past regret about wasted time needs 'if only + past perfect'.
